**If You use the Scandit App to scan Your identification document (ID) which corresponds to the AAMVA standards, Scandit may transfer personal data encoded in the scanned barcodes of such ID to AAMVA.**
Purpose: our legitimate interests to improve and develop our products and services and for debugging, statistical analysis, and performance monitoring. AAMVA will use Your personal data to confirm whether the scanned ID is likely a genuine ID.
**Exercising Your rights (** **_“Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information”, “Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information”_** **):**
If you do not wish Your data to be shared with AAMVA (or any other processors), please do not scan Your ID. If you wish to access Your data, have it deleted or limit the sharing and other processing of your data, please use the form provided in the Scandit App available via the App’s “About” menu (in the “About” menu, click “Privacy & Terms”.
If you have any questions related to AAMVA’s processing of your data via Scandit Apps, please reach out to Scandit via the form provided in the Scandit App.
**Scandit does not sell Your data.** | | AAMVA
